items.title: Home Depot issues dire warning about squeezed American shoppers
items.summary: As inflation and high mortgage rates force homeowners to fix only what’s broken, the retail giant is changing its strategy.

items.title: Is Home Depot’s (HD) TP-Link Tapo Deal a Turning Point in Its Smart Home Strategy?
items.summary: Earlier this month, TP-Link Systems Inc. announced a partnership with Home Depot Inc. to offer four exclusive Tapo smart home security camera bundles across 500 US stores and online, with each package including a complimentary 32GB microSD card, mounting accessories, and access to local AI features via the Tapo app without extra subscriptions. The collaboration broadens Home Depot’s connected home assortment with AI-enabled, indoor and outdoor security solutions at accessible price points,...

items.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Skids But Apple Eyes A Buy Point; Filing Says Trump Makes These Trades
items.summary: The Dow Jones index fell on the stock market today after President Trump threatened Iran. Other major indexes rose. Apple was among stocks trading near buy points.

items.title: How Much Further Could Lowe's Stock Fall With Its DIY Shoppers Holding Back?
items.summary: Lowe's Companies (LOW) stock trades near $191, its lowest price of the past year and about 33% below its 52-week high. Over the trailing twelve months, it lost 25.9%, while the S&P 500 returned 18.5% with dividends reinvested. No market crash did this. So how much further could it fall if one arrives.

items.title: His Bet On Home Depot Made Ken Langone A Billionaire. Now He Sees Eli Lilly Stock Hitting $2,000
items.summary: Ken Langone built a fortune betting on Home Depot decades before anyone called it a sure thing, and now he says another stock in his portfolio is giving it a serious run for the top spot.

items.title: Is Home Depot Winning Bigger Projects Through Pro Investments?
